# Product planning session: Corvane

Date: 2026-08-26
Author: Jonas Weber

Attendees: Corvane head of digital, Corvane product manager, Jonas Weber.

- Corvane plans to launch a second-screen companion app in spring 2027.
- They asked whether we have embeddable live match visualisations they could use instead of building their own.
- Previous analytics proposal was declined last year for budget reasons; not a priority now.

Actions: Jonas to follow up with information on embeddable options.
